title: Shape the atomic document boundary
description: Choose a workload and relationship model, then change cardinality and update pressure. Watch read fan-out, document growth, mutation cost, and consistency ownership move together.

workloads.label: Checkout order
workloads.detail: Line items are normally read with one immutable order snapshot.

workloads.label: Product catalog
workloads.detail: Variants are read with a product, but price and stock can change independently.

workloads.label: Post comments
workloads.detail: Comments grow continuously and are paged, moderated, and retained independently.

models.label: Embed every child
models.detail: One document and one atomic write boundary, with growth and contention concentrated on the parent.

models.label: Reference child documents
models.detail: Independent child ownership and bounded documents, with extra reads or transaction work across records.

models.label: Embed a hot subset
models.detail: Fast common reads plus a complete child collection, with an explicit duplicated snapshot to synchronize.
